vehicle_photo_file.name: vehicle_photo_file
vehicle_photo_file.value: (storage_key is null) = (content_type is null) and (storage_key is null) = (size is null)

vehicle_photo_kind.name: vehicle_photo_kind
vehicle_photo_kind.value: content_type is null or content_type in ('image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/webp')

customer_flag_closed.name: customer_flag_closed
customer_flag_closed.value: (closed_at is null) = (closed_by is null) and (closed_at is null) = (close_reason is null)

reference_person_relationship.name: reference_person_relationship
reference_person_relationship.value: relationship is null or relationship in ('family', 'friend', 'employer', 'other')

rental_deposit.name: rental_deposit
rental_deposit.value: (deposit_amount is null or deposit_amount between 1 and 500000) and not (deposit_amount is not null and deposit_waived_reason is not null)

rental_rent_paid.name: rental_rent_paid
rental_rent_paid.value: rent_paid is null or rent_paid in ('now', 'return')

rental_fuel.name: rental_fuel
rental_fuel.value: fuel is null or fuel in ('notCounted', 'sameLevel')

rental_reference_only_if_required.name: rental_reference_only_if_required
rental_reference_only_if_required.value: reference_person_id is null or reference_required = true

rental_terms_complete.name: rental_terms_complete
rental_terms_complete.value: terms_set_at is null or ((deposit_amount is not null or deposit_waived_reason is not null) and rent_paid is not null and fuel is not null and reference_required is not null)

cash_movement_payment_in.name: cash_movement_payment_in
cash_movement_payment_in.value: kind <> 'paymentIn' or payment_id is not null

deposit_movement_received_has_payment.name: deposit_movement_received_has_payment
deposit_movement_received_has_payment.value: kind <> 'received' or payment_id is not null

approval_decision_reject_note.name: approval_decision_reject_note
approval_decision_reject_note.value: outcome <> 'rejected' or (note is not null and length(note) > 0)

approval_decision_split.name: approval_decision_split
approval_decision_split.value: (partner_extra is null) = (split_reason is null) and (partner_extra is null or (outcome = 'approved' and partner_extra >= 0))

approval_request_kind.name: approval_request_kind
approval_request_kind.value: (kind = 'rate' and new_daily_rate between 1 and 100000 and discount is null) or (kind = 'discount' and discount >= 1 and new_daily_rate is null)
